narrative.offerRewardText: The Sparklematic 5200 comes to life, lurching to and fro. Inside, the helpless grime that has encrusted the object placed within it is being pulverized by the machine's gnomish cleaning agent.The Sparklematic 5200 comes to a halt, heralded by a familiar "ding!" The item receptacle of the machine spirals open, revealing a neatly wrapped box.
narrative.requestItemsText: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!

chain.subtitle: 3 quests at level 30, 2,450 XP in all.

quests.name: The Sparklematic 5200!
quests.objectiveText: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.
